verdict.rationale: Angular is a web UI framework and development platform. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a capability of workflow or automation platforms, so this axis does not fit the product type. The CLI commands for build, update, schematics and deploy are developer tooling, not versioned automations with review or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
